_comment: Screenshot inventory in logical training order. 'source' is the original capture in Images/ (kept locally, not committed). 'redact' boxes are [x1, y1, x2, y2] in original pixel space and are pixelated + blurred in the published copy because they contain credentials or personal contact details. 'shift' [dx, dy] aligns before/after captures of the same screen so they crossfade without jitter.
